name: Make.com Migration Audit Checklist
description: Structured checklist for auditing and migrating Make.com scenarios between organizations. Covers scenario inventory, dependency mapping, connection re-establishment, and validation.
author: UnpauseAI

tasks.task: Export all scenario blueprints from current account
tasks.notes: Use Make.com API or manual export. Save as JSON files.

tasks.task: List all active scenarios with their triggers
tasks.notes: Document: scenario name, trigger type (webhook/scheduled/instant), schedule interval.

tasks.task: List all draft and disabled scenarios
tasks.notes: Decide with client: migrate or discard?
Record: name, structure, record count, which scenarios read/write.
Map each webhook to its source system (Hero, LexOffice, etc.).
List connection type, auth method (API key, OAuth), and which scenarios use each.
Identify scenarios that trigger other scenarios via webhooks or data stores.
Which scenarios depend on Hero? LexOffice? Mailgun? OpenAI? S3?
Independent scenarios first, dependent scenarios after their dependencies are live.
Scenarios with: hardcoded values, complex routing, multiple API calls, rate-limited APIs.
Obtain API credentials. Test with a read-only call before migrating scenarios.
REST API, 2 req/sec rate limit. Test with contacts list call.
Verify domain, SMTP credentials, and sending limits.
API key, model selection, rate limits.
Bucket name, region, IAM credentials, verify read/write access.
Match structure from old account. Import existing records if needed.
Scenarios with no cross-dependencies. Test each individually.
Scenarios that depend on group 1. Update internal webhook URLs.

tasks.task: Update webhook URLs in source systems
tasks.notes: Coordinate with sysadmin. Schedule cutover window to minimize dropped events.
Trigger with real or test data. Verify output in destination system.
Where safe to do so (avoid duplicate emails/invoices).
Check for errors, timeouts, unexpected data formats.
Email or Slack alerts on scenario failures.
Spot-check records in Hero and LexOffice to confirm sync accuracy.
Disable (not delete) old scenarios. Keep blueprints as backup for 30 days.
